crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.
Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion…
Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.
A feast is made for laughter, and wine makes the life glad; and money is the answer for all things.

but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break…

but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

translations.web: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man swallows it up.
translations.bsb: Precious treasures and oil are in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man consumes them.
translations.kjv: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
translations.asv: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; But a foolish man swalloweth it up.
